property_summary: For any caller address A, the reference contract allows the current owner to call setOwner (i.e. calls from msg.sender==owner succeed); the mutant additionally requires msg.sender==tx.origin, so a call that is relayed through a contract (msg.sender != tx.origin) made by the owner via a contract will be rejected — violating the rule for some inputs where the owner calls through a contract.
change_summary: Replace the require condition to check msg.sender == tx.origin so only direct EOA callers (not contracts) which are equal to owner can call functions guarded by onlyOwner, changing setOwner's accessibility when called via contracts.
